description: This file is a factory class for creating and managing AccessControlList and related objects such as Permissions, AclEntry, and builders in the context of org.eclipse.ditto.model.things. It provides static methods for instantiation, combination, and JSON parsing of ACL-related objects, and is marked as deprecated.

classes.name: AccessControlListModelFactory
classes.description: A utility class providing static factory methods for creating ACLs, permissions, and entries, handling JSON conversions, and building ACLs in an immutable fashion.

methods.name: noPermissions
methods.description: Returns a new empty mutable Permissions object.

methods.name: allPermissions
methods.description: Returns a new Permissions object containing all permissions.

methods.name: newPermissions
methods.description: Creates a Permissions object initialized with a collection of permissions.

methods.name: newPermissions
methods.description: Creates a Permissions object with a specified permission and additional permissions.

methods.name: newUnmodifiablePermissions
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable Permissions object with specified permissions.

methods.name: newAclEntry
methods.description: Creates a new immutable AclEntry with given AuthorizationSubject and permissions.

methods.name: newAclEntry
methods.description: Creates an immutable AclEntry with given AuthorizationSubject and a collection of permissions.

methods.name: newAclEntry
methods.description: Creates an immutable AclEntry from a JsonObject.

methods.name: newAclEntry
methods.description: Creates an AclEntry with a given authorization subject identifier and permissions JSON value.

methods.name: newAclBuilder
methods.description: Returns a new builder for constructing immutable AccessControlList.

methods.name: newAclBuilder
methods.description: Returns a new builder initialized with a collection of AclEntries.

methods.name: newAclBuilder
methods.description: Returns a new builder initialized with an optional collection of AclEntries.

methods.name: emptyAcl
methods.description: Returns a new empty immutable AccessControlList.

methods.name: newAcl
methods.description: Creates an immutable AccessControlList from provided AclEntries.

methods.name: newAcl
methods.description: Creates an immutable AccessControlList from an Iterable of AclEntries.

methods.name: newAcl
methods.description: Creates an immutable AccessControlList from a JSON object.

methods.name: newAcl
methods.description: Creates an immutable AccessControlList from a JSON string.
